checks.what: Middle Kingdom gains the Siut valley from nobody in -2033. The page supports the year and the parties: Mentuhotep II 'would eventually defeat the Heracleopolitan kings around 2033 BC' and reunify Egypt, and 'The Siut province acted as a buffer state between the northern and southern rulers'. The region was too narrow. intersect(MK -2000, Abydos 60 km | Asyut gov.) filled 8 nobody's cells, but it left out the two Siut cells that events/1 and keyframe_overrides/1 empty: 27.09 N 31.12 E (beside Asyut city, west bank) and 27.20 N 31.41 E. It also left out 27.10 N 30.93 E. My trial of the original patch showed these 3 cells nobody's inside the kingdom's own outline for -2033..-2001, and the first two had been Middle Kingdom land before the patch. So the patch fixed one notch at Siut and opened another.
